# made.expert

> Business development consultancy for consulting boutiques and independent consultants.

made.expert is the business of Katerina Braga, operating as Marketing Agency "Digital Energy" e.U., based in Vienna, Austria. Katerina spent 20 years on the client side of B2B marketing and communications in the energy, IT, and industrial sectors, building marketing and communications functions from scratch five times. She holds a 2025 diploma from Oxford College of Marketing. Since 2023 she has worked independently, helping consulting boutiques and independent consultants (across strategy, operations, industrial, energy, supply chain, IT, HR, and marketing consulting) build a repeatable system for winning clients, instead of relying on referrals alone.

Her offer runs as a four-stage program: Audit, Strategy Sprint, Launch, and Maintenance, built on what she calls the Consulting Growth Framework (Foundation, Connection, Execution). She works as a solo practitioner and is personally responsible for the results, bringing in subcontractors for specific pieces like design or technical setup when needed.

Contact: kate@made.expert
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/katerina-braga/
Booking a call: https://zcal.co/katerinabraga/call
